newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amer. Stores, Food Lion.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amer. Stores, Food Lion.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros intitiated coverage of Food Lion Inc and American Stores Co with outperform ratings, according to a Lehman source.
-- Analyst Meredith Adler's office confirmed the moves and the ratings.
-- The Food Lion one-year target price is $11 per share.
-- American Stores' target price is $48 per share.
-- Food Lion shares rose 1/8 to 9-1/8 in early Nasdaq trade while American Stores shares were untraded on the NYSE due to an imbalance but were indicated to open about two points higher from 40-3/4.
